items.title: Stock Market LIVE: Sensex rises 100 pts, Nifty near 23,300; India VIX down 3%
items.description: Sensex Today | Stock Market LIVE Updates Friday: In the broader markets, the Nifty MidCap and the Nifty SmallCap rose 0.48 per cent and 0.7 per cent, respectively

items.title: Hi-Tech Flow Solutions files IPO papers, seeks ₹300 cr via fresh issue
items.description: The proposed IPO comprises a fresh issue of up to Rs 300 crore and an offer-for-sale by promoters and an investor, according to the draft red herring prospectus (DRHP) filed on Thursday
